Spacing/grade conflicts remain in supplied airpark and legacy backcountry allocation. AP2 moved to (-6.9,6.8), four fictional airpark elevations adjusted and KMEV group shifted 150 m east; approve those proposals. IFR remains Claude-owned and unchanged.
Strict 20:1 from every runway end conflicts with one-way terrain and Drake cliff/hologram. Clarify exceptions; no locked geometry silently changed.

Drake 5750 ft peak and 4700 ft valley differ by 1050 ft / 320.04 m; 320 m relief is rounded. Resolve crown centre (-4.9,-4.5) versus DRK (-4.9,-4.3) and 60 m roof cover near dome edges in detailed shell design.
PALH gravel elevation unspecified: provisionally 79 ft same as water lane; needs true field datum confirmation.
3U2 slope 0.5% is a target pending real longitudinal survey; KMEV glider strip dimensions are targets.
T201 fix coordinates and non-KSNA missed/hold geometries are not supplied: full zone/airway clearance cannot be established; Claude must supply final geometry.

100 m design bake is not flight-certified or an engine import; source analytic API has no baked format. Fine terrain/solid continuity, cave roofs, forest/buildings and loaded-trainer climb validation await Phase 1B and Claude.
Initial field centres and true headings do not always reproduce stated IFR lines exactly (e.g. KSNA supplied threshold); IFR data remains unchanged; Claude reconciles geometry after approval.
Review fit-check failures and decide whether to authorize a revised layout at G1a; this draft is not a passing world or G1 approval.
Gunnery targets are now over water: six moored bullseye rafts per active zone. Claude must adapt ground-hit height logic and drone/cloud placement; no land added in MOAs.

Drake interior cannot be validated by a single upper-surface bake. The height-aware cave floor/deck and collision routing must preserve the roof while allowing underground flight; Phase1B shell validation required.

AB1 judges line south of the offshore square is still over water; a literal shore marker on that line may not intersect the authored beach. Confirm a shore-aligned extension/reference marker rather than moving the locked box dimensions.
